_note: The village's footbath (ashiyu, map prop `ashiyu` with "use": "soak"; 2026-11-20, where the station east of the main street stood). E from a seat (the cell before the middle of either long side, facing the tub: Game.soak_spots; anywhere else says `seat_message`): the farmer sits down over `sit_seconds` along `sit_path` (from behind `sit_path_back`): keys of [t (0..1 of the way), seat (cells toward the tub), lift (units up in 3D), pose], the seat and lift eased between keys (Game._soak_path: smoothstep per segment, so never a jump), the pose of the key a stretch starts from (Game.still_pose): a few steps toward the tub (walk), bending (soak_down), sat on the bench behind the rim (soak), the legs lifting (soak_lift), swung up over the rim as he moves to its edge (soak_swing), coming down (soak_lift), the feet in the water (soak; `feet_in` the t from which they are in: the flat view's water band). He walks from where he stood onto the seat cell up to `step_until`. The sound `soak_in` as he settles; getting up runs the same keys back over `stand_seconds` (`soak_out`). The user found the jumps and the glide through the rim unnatural (2026-11-22) and gets up the same way back over `stand_seconds` (`soak_out`), never a jump. Sat on its bench, the feet in the water (the sitting pose "soak", FigureArt; the figure drawn `seat` cells from the farmer's spot toward the tub, raised `lift` (units) in 3D so the hips sit at the bench's height and only the feet go below the water's top; seen from behind (facing up, the far seat) on the rim itself, `seat_back` and `lift_back`, the legs hidden in front of him; in the flat view from the front a band of water over the feet) and stays there, the clock running, until E is pressed again (the hint "Get up"; a map change or the day's end stands him up too). The first soak of a day gives `stamina` (up to the max) and takes `fatigue` off (a cup of green tea is 5 / -5, a night's sleep at least -10), and says `message`; a later soak the same day only rests the feet and says `again_message` (Game.soaked_today, saved, cleared each morning). Not while holding something overhead or cradling the little one (`hands_message`). Balance numbers are ours: worth a walk into the village on a long day, never a stand-in for sleep.
message: You soak your feet in the hot spring water. The tiredness eases.
again_message: You soak your feet a while. They're still warm from earlier.
hands_message: Put down what you're holding first.
seat_message: Sit down in the middle of the bench.
